# UPS To Release Third-Quarter 2026 Results On Tuesday, October 27, 2026


[Download as PDF](https://investors.ups.com/_assets/_9262133c36404be24db33ee7b5a2e11e/ups/news/2026-10-13_UPS_To_Release_Third_Quarter_2026_Results_On_2171.pdf) October 13, 2026 4:15pm EDT


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- United Parcel Service (NYSE:UPS) will announce its 2026 third-quarter results on October 27, 2026, at approximately 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time.


At 8:30 a.m. ET, UPS Chief Executive Officer Carol Tomé and Chief Financial Officer Brian Dykes will lead an investor conference call to discuss the results. This call will be open to the public via a live webcast.


To listen, visit the[UPS Investor Relations](https://www.investors.ups.com/) page and click on “Webcast.” The webcast audio will be accessible on the Investor Relations website for a limited time following the call.
